messages:
alex: quick FYI — i'm going to tweak the route -> logging routing so low-volume debug routes skip full req/resp capture by default. we found ~40% of telemetry spend was coming from ephemeral debug traffic across a handful of internal routes. change is a sampling override for routes with label `debug=true`.

maria: will this still scrub PII? we can't send full user messages to logs under any circumstance.

alex: yes — redaction pipeline is unchanged. sampling happens before serialization; any captured payload still passes through the redactor.
redactor config for clarity: `pii_mode: strict` for hosted; `per-tenant` exceptions must be explicit and audited.

sam: can you paste the sampling rule you're planning to apply?

alex: sure — pseudocode below:
```
# sampling rule applied at ingress routing layer
if route.labels.debug == true:
  sampling_rate = min(route.sampling_override || 0.02, 0.05)  # default 2%, max 5%
else:
  sampling_rate = route.default_sampling || global_default
```
Note: sampling_rate is evaluated before any redaction/serialization.

jin: for the console UX, let's expose an "inspect-mode" toggle scoped to orgs + a canary flag. show the effective sample rate and the retention window in the route detail page.

teresa: how will this affect billing and quotas? we bill for tokens served to customers — telemetry storage/ingest is billed separately but still matters for cost.

alex: billing for customer API calls is unchanged. the sampling rule reduces telemetry ingress/storage and therefore telemetry billing. it'll not change customer metering.

maria: we need an audit event when an org opts into inspect-mode and for any per-tenant redaction exception. legal/privacy want a short audit trail and exportable consent record.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: platform/logging-sampler v2 -> 10% traffic (env=staging)

sam: :eyes:

alex: can we run a short eval on a representative prompt set to make sure redaction fidelity doesn't regress? cc @maria

maria: yep — i'll run a 500-sample eval tomorrow and post results (checking name/email/ssn heuristics + manual review on borderline cases).

jin: UI note: add an "effective sample rate" column to the routes table and link each route to the sampling policy JSON. also show "estimated monthly telemetry cost" when toggling inspect-mode.

alex: filing GH: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/5123 — will add backend guard to prevent accidental global flips.

teresa: oncall concern: if someone flips inspect-mode for a large org it could spike storage/ingest. add a guard: automatic billing cap + require owners approval for orgs > 50k reqs/day.

sam: +1 — also require two-step confirmation on the console modal for >= 50k reqs/day.

alex: noted. i'll add backend quota guard + UI modal. plan is to roll this in 48h unless anyone objects.

maria: no objections from privacy; please include a changelog note and link to the privacy checklist used for the eval.

jin: i'll open the console PR and tag owners: @maria @teresa @sam

alex: thanks all — merging canary tomorrow. :rocket:
